notes.title: August 22th Update: New Ready-to-Win Feature, Bug Fixes & Stats Live
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone, the weekly update of [i]Demonic Mahjong[/i] is now live! This update not only adds the new feature of automatic selling of offerings when ready to win but also fully fixes bugs such as Olden pattern calculations and BOSS skills. At the same time, it optimizes the backpack information display effect, adjusts the battle mechanism, and even enhances the values of some figurines and relics~[/p][p]Details of this update are as follows:[/p][p]New Additions:[/p][list][*][p]Added the function of automatic selling of offerings after getting ready to win.[/p][/*][*][p]Added display of players' basic information in the backpack interface: in-game gold earned, out-of-game gold earned, shop discounts, number of tile swaps, number of tiles drawn per round, total number of tiles drawn, and Hu Slot.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes:[/p][list][*][p]Fixed the calculation issue of Olden: Double Helix pattern.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where tiles with Demon Spirit couldn't form Olden: Seven Stars.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the calculation issue of the Perfect Uniformity pattern.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect calculation of High Tiles and Low Tiles on the backpack hover page during battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the tile-splitting issue when displaying the large pattern Nine Gates.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the inconsistency of spirits between the in-battle backpack hover page and the opened backpack page.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where Meng Po boss's active skill "Brewing" deducts soul power twice.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where the Virtue Judge character couldn't receive rewards in a draw.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the issue where Olden: One Million Koku didn't trigger.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the incorrect effect of Paperweight, which reduced the boss's base score.[/p][/*][/list][p]Optimization Content:[/p][list][*][p]Optimized some multilingual adaptations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added "revealed tiles" and "hand tiles" entries to the collection hover text.[/p][/*][*][p]Modified the battle end conditions: Original mechanism: The battle ends when one side fills the Hu Slot and the other side exhausts the current drawable tiles. New mechanism: When the BOSS fills the Hu Slot and the player exhausts the current drawable tiles, the battle continues, and the BOSS continues to draw tiles; When the player fills the Hu Slot and the BOSS exhausts the current drawable tiles, the battle ends.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated values for Stacked Puck: Base score +10→+20.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated values for Wax Monkey: +10→+15, -2→-3.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated values for Drunk Monkey: +6→+10.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated values for Absent Puck: +60→+100.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted values for Qingming Sword: 150→200.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted values for Vajra: 15→25.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted values for Cosmic Ring: 10→15.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.content:
Hello, fellow Mahjong enthusiasts! We're about to roll out a new game update today. Based on the version released yesterday, the new update mainly fixes and adjusts the following issues: (We're still working hard to figure out the cause of the lag issue after winning a hand, which was originally planned to be fixed in this update. We'll strive to optimize it in the next version as soon as possible.)

[list]
[*] The passive skill of the Self-Isolating Female Ghost has been revised to increase the soul power cap.
[*] The problem of being unable to use sacrifices when playing against the Black Impermanence has been fixed.
[*] The issue that the Black Impermanence's active skill causes an extra tile to appear in the player's hand when there are pungs in the open-tile area, which in turn makes the game unplayable, has been fixed.
[*] The problem of being unable to play the game after clicking "Continue" in the settings to turn off some sound effects has been fixed.
[*] The error of over-calculating values such as the base score and multiplier has been fixed.
[*] The bug that players can't enter the game after clicking "Continue" in the player announcement interface has been fixed.
[*] The bug that characters in the backpack appear to be clipping through when entering the store interface has been fixed.
[*] The operation logic for obtaining spirit figurines has been adjusted: After obtaining a spirit figurine, if there is an empty slot in the spirit figurine slot, it will be placed in the slot first; if there is no empty slot in the spirit figurine slot but there is one in the warehouse, it will be placed directly in the warehouse; if both sides have no empty slots, the player will be prompted to destroy it.
[*] The problem of the subtitles and the song not matching during the second playback of the main interface song has been fixed (However, when players switch out of the game and then come back, the BGM and subtitles will still not match. This will be fixed in the next version).
[*] The problem of incorrect numerical display of some spirit figurines in the base score and multiplier panels has been fixed.
[*] Some bugs on some spirit figurines have been optimized (Bug in the numerical display of the Sacrifice Monster, Kirin effect updated, bug in the numerical display of the Pixiu, numerical problem of the Unity Doll, bug in the numerical display of the Phoenix, modification of the Phoenix value, modification of the Candle Monkey value, modification of the Candle Figure value, optimization of the triggering experience of the Satisfied Cat, modification of the Ordinary Doll value, modification of the Lost Soul Doll effect).
[*] The effect of the Cursed Treasure Chest has been optimized (It will now prioritize destroying spirit figurines in the warehouse).
[*] The problem that the relic effect is not removed after the Transformation Talisman is transformed has been fixed.
[/list]

Thank you all for your support and love!

tags.bug: The problem of being unable to use sacrifices when playing against the Black Impermanence has been fixed.

The issue that the Black Impermanence's active skill causes an extra tile to appear in the player's hand when there are pungs in the open-tile area, which in turn makes the game unplayable, has been fixed.
The problem of being unable to play the game after clicking "Continue" in the settings to turn off some sound effects has been fixed.
The error of over-calculating values such as the base score and multiplier has been fixed.
The bug that players can't enter the game after clicking "Continue" in the player announcement interface has been fixed.
The bug that characters in the backpack appear to be clipping through when entering the store interface has been fixed.

tags.balance_change: The operation logic for obtaining spirit figurines has been adjusted: After obtaining a spirit figurine, if there is an empty slot in the spirit figurine slot, it will be placed in the slot first; if there is no empty slot in the spirit figurine slot but there is one in the warehouse, it will be placed directly in the warehouse; if both sides have no empty slots, the player will be prompted to destroy it.

tags.bug: The problem of the subtitles and the song not matching during the second playback of the main interface song has been fixed (However, when players switch out of the game and then come back, the BGM and subtitles will still not match. This will be fixed in the next version).
The problem of incorrect numerical display of some spirit figurines in the base score and multiplier panels has been fixed.

Some bugs on some spirit figurines have been optimized (Bug in the numerical display of the Sacrifice Monster, Kirin effect updated, bug in the numerical display of the Pixiu, numerical problem of the Unity Doll, bug in the numerical display of the Phoenix, modification of the Phoenix value, modification of the Candle Monkey value, modification of the Candle Figure value, optimization of the triggering experience of the Satisfied Cat, modification of the Ordinary Doll value, modification of the Lost Soul Doll effect).

tags.balance_change: The effect of the Cursed Treasure Chest has been optimized (It will now prioritize destroying spirit figurines in the warehouse).

tags.bug: The problem that the relic effect is not removed after the Transformation Talisman is transformed has been fixed.

notes.title: Major updates including content adjustments, new character additions, bug fixes
notes.content:
Hello, fellow Mahjong enthusiasts! Thank you all for your attention and support for Demonic Mahjong. Over the past week, we've been working overtime to optimize the game and develop subsequent content. In the newly released version update, we mainly carried out the following: [Bug Fixes], [Game Function/Interaction Optimization], [Content Adjustment], and [Addition of New Characters and Adjustment of Character Skills]. Of course, there are still some known bugs and issues in the latest version. We will continue to update and optimize the game in the future. Wish you all a pleasant gaming experience!

[b][Bug Fixes][/b]
[list]
[*] Fix the problems of map nodes getting stuck, failing to trigger, or automatically skipping.
[*] Fix the discovery status of treasure tile spirits in the collection.
[*] Fix the problem that certain combinations of tiles cannot unlock spirit figurines after being achieved.
[*] Fix the problem of the backpack tile deck page showing through other pages on some interfaces.
[*] Fix the problems of unlocking and saving spirit figurines, relics in the favorites list.
[*] Fix the problem of incorrect difficulty information display.
[*] Fix the problem that an extra empty spirit figurine is displayed when previewing the cruel zombie boss.
[*] Fix the problem that destroyed spirit figurines still show in the warehouse.
[*] Fix the problem that the "Red Skull" doesn't get [Power Up] when drawing a tile after a winning hand and a sequence draw.
[*] Fix the issue that the game freezes after exiting the forging station without selecting a treasure tile.
[*] Fix the problem of the spirit figurine slot obtained by destroying the "Lotus Package".
[*] Fix the problem that placeholder spirit figurines sometimes appear in the warehouse.
[*] The initially unlocked and newly discovered spirit figurines, sacrifices, and relics do not appear on the final reward page.
[*] Add the function of continuing to play tiles even after the winning tile slot is full.
[*] Fix the problem that the sacrifice given by the "Mother-of-Pearl Tile" after a waiting hand is not grayed out.
[*] Fix the calculation problem of the "All One Suit with Four Pungs" combination.
[*] Fix the problem of incorrect description display after using sacrifices or character skills.
[*] Fix the abnormal display of the score on the winning hand panel.
[*] Fix the abnormal tile face and direction after using the "Herbal Grass for Exchanging Tiles".
[*] Fix the problem that the number of hand tiles becomes abnormal when clicking a concealed kong during the discarding phase.
[*] Fix the problem that the talent bonus to the base score doesn't take effect during a game.
[*] Fix the problem that the boss uses the tile-exchanging skill after the player gets ready to win.
[*] Fix the calculation problem of the "Double Pungs" combination.
[*] Fix the calculation problem of "Anger".
[*] Fix the problem that you can't get ready to win after exchanging tiles with the opponent's tile exchange area.
[*] Adjust the loading logic of the poison treasure tile special effect.
[*] Add a special effect for selling sacrifices during a game.
[*] Fix the problem that Qin Guangwang is unlikely to get ready to win.
[*] Fix the problem that the double consumption buff still exists after the "Pixiu" is destroyed.
[*] Fix the problem that the growth progress of the "Pixiu" is not saved after entering a new game.
[*] Fix the problem that sacrifices obtained by playing mother-of-pearl tiles during a game with "Yinshi Coins" can be sold for money.
[*] Fix the problem of the "Treasure Vase" giving cursed relics.
[*] Fix the problem that the base score bonus of the "Egg in an Egg" doesn't take effect.
[*] Modify the calculation rules of the "Open-Handed Clear" combination.
[*] Fix the tile-changing problem of the "Fox Spirit for Calculating".
[*] Fix the problem of over-calculating the base score of the "Three Brothers".
[*] Fix the problem that the base score bonus of the "Three-Headed Dog" is not included in the current winning hand.
[*] Fix the problem that the combination display area on the winning hand panel changes to 1 when settling the "Three-Headed Dog" combination.
[*] Fix the problem that the "Red Dragon" initially shows a +100% multiplier.
[*] Fix the problem that the progress of the "Red Treasure Ox" is not recorded across games.
[*] Fix the problem that the "Satisfied Cat" doesn't preferentially attach to tiles without spirit figurines.
[*] Fix the multiplier display problem of the "Kirin".
[*] Fix the problem that the character tiles of the "Angry Imp" are not counted as terminals.
[*] Fix the problem of the base score display of the "Little Mouse".
[*] Fix the multiplier calculation and display problems of the "Big Elephant".
[*] Fix the effective effect of egg-type spirit figurines on the map.
[*] Fix the effective effect of the "Treasure-Bringing Cat".
[*] Fix the effective effect of the "Money-Bringing Cat".
[*] Fix the problem of calculating the number of tube tiles of the "Advancing Turtle".
[/list]

[b][Function/Interaction Optimization][/b]
[list]
[*] Optimize the event content: Most of the event rewards will be reflected in the options.
[*] Add special effects to the talent page.
[*] Optimize the hover effect of soul power and gold coins.
[*] Optimize the UI of the character selection page.
[*] Add a sacrifice shop function in events.
[*] Replace the soul power icon and special effects with green.
[*] Optimize the buff icons, layers, and hover information.
[*] Significantly increase the appearance probability of the Phantom Terrace on the map.
[*] Add a default sacrifice of "Goji Berry" at the start of games with difficulties 1 - 3.
[*] Add a node movement special effect.
[*] Remove the "Five-Colored Divine Ox" skill from the Kind Judge in low-difficulty games.
[*] Temporarily close the "Combination Bounty" system.
[*] Optimize the character introduction page.
[*] Add a "Skip" button in the interaction pages of "Underground Vine" and "Enchanting Incense".
[*] After obtaining a spirit figurine, if there is an empty slot in the spirit figurine slot, prioritize placing it in the slot; if there is no empty slot in the spirit figurine slot but there is one in the warehouse, place it directly in the warehouse; only prompt to destroy the spirit figurine when both are full.
[*] Add lyrics display on the main interface.
[*] Add the function of selling sacrifices after getting ready to win.
[*] Optimize the music when some bosses get ready to win.
[/list]

[b]Game Content Adjustment:[/b]
[list]
[*] Add a mysterious relic of "Moonlight Box Fragment" at the start of games with difficulty 1, which can be used to replace the boss you don't want to play against.
[*] Add the talent "Prajna Paramita".
[*] Open up more mysterious relics.
[*] Update the effect of Obsession.
[*] Update the effect of the "Seven-Star Lamp".
[*] Update the effect of the "Auspicious Doll".
[*] Update the effect of the "Pump Doll".
[*] Update the effect of the "Seeking Doll".
[*] Update the effect of the "Scholar Doll".
[*] Update the effect of the "Ordinary Imp".
[*] Update the effect of the "Ordinary Doll".
[*] Update the effect of "Dangkang".
[*] Update the effect of the "Terrifying Candle".
[*] Update the effect of the "Lotus Lantern".
[*] Update the effect of ghost spirits.
[*] Update the effect of the "Golden Toad".
[*] Update the effect of the boss spirit figurine "Guiding Ghost Messenger".
[*] Optimize the skills of the Meng Po boss.
[*] Optimize the beginner tutorial.
[*] Change the rank of Pi to 128.
[*] Add some boss actions.
[*] Add winning hand-related sound effects.
[*] Add new spirit figurines "Wind-Generated Fox" and "Young Fox".
[*] The base score, multiplier, winning hand slot, and estimated total score of the boss are now affected by the difficulty value.
[/list]

[b]Character Skill Adjustment:[/b]
[list]
[*] Optimize the skills of the Black Impermanence character.
[*] Optimize the skills of the Cruel Zombie character.
[*] Optimize the active skills of the Greedy Zombie character.
[*] Add a new character: Non-Touching Zombie.
[*] Add a new character: Greedy Zombie.
[/list]

notes.content:

[*] Fix for the active skill of the Reclusive Ghost.
[*] Fix for the Green Dragon Figurine.
[*] Fix for the White Dragon Figurine.
[*] The issue where the boss and a full card slot would cause the game to freeze.
[*] The issue where using certain sacrifices would cause the game to freeze.
[*] Problems with unlocking relics and sacrifices.
[*] Fix for duplicate resolution options.
[*] Optimization of some actions and special effects.
[*] In some cases, the "Winning" panel would display 0 points.
[*] Other optimizations and bug fixes.
[/list]

Thank you all for your support and understanding. Wish all the mahjong players a great time!

notes.title: Demo version coming on April 11th.
notes.content:
Welcome to your exciting journey through the netherworld in Demonic Mahjong! 
We are delighted to announce the game's demo version will be available on Steam on April 11. 
The game is still under emergency construction in the depths of the Yama’s Palace, so don’t be surprised if the UI gets a little mischievous or some bugs cause a ruckus. Please bear with us—we’re working hard every day to exorcise the chaos!
Want early access to some juicy underworld secrets?
Behold this special construction schedule, approved by King Yama himself!
And hey, if you have ideas or just want to chat, come join us at the netherworld Tea Party—everyone’s welcome!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45453388/78244a4447d6c86a6174eb9d7df2403aae829305.jpg[/img]

◆ Underworld Hotline ◆
Discord: https://discord.gg/gmkBmQKM

◆ Current Construction Progress ◆
- Touch system
- Stories
- Affinity development system
- You can change your favorite character on the main menu
- More characters and opponents: four ghost brides, a nitpicker (actually quite cute, Orz)
- Stronger final bosses: King Yama, Kṣitigarbha 
- After defeating the final bosses, you can enter the 18th level of the netherworld and challenge the Ten Kings
Update Frequency: We’ll be serving up new soul-training content every 1–2 months. Expect a big Version 2.0 Demo Update by the end of April!

May the tiles be ever in your favor!
